description: This file defines the interface for the CmduMessageRx class, which inherits from CmduMessage and provides functions for parsing and handling TLV (Type-Length-Value) messages in the ieee1905_1 namespace. It includes methods for accessing TLV classes and type information, as well as parsing individual TLVs from a buffer.

classes.name: CmduMessageRx
classes.description: A class that extends CmduMessage to provide specialized parsing for TLV-based messages, including functions to get TLV types, subtypes, and parse TLVs based on different TLV type maps.

methods.name: CmduMessageRx(uint8_t *buff, size_t buff_len)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message with a buffer and its length.

methods.name: getClass<T>()
methods.description: Template method to retrieve a shared pointer to a class of type T from the message.

methods.name: getClassList<T>()
methods.description: Template method to retrieve a list of shared pointers to classes of type T from the message.

methods.name: parse()
methods.description: Parse the message buffer to interpret its contents.

methods.name: getNextTlvType()
methods.description: Retrieve the type of the next TLV.

methods.name: getNextTlvLength()
methods.description: Retrieve the length of the next TLV.

methods.name: getNextTlvSubtype()
methods.description: Retrieve the subtype of the next TLV, or UINT16_MAX if there is no CMDU header.

methods.name: parseNextTlv()
methods.description: Parse the next TLV regardless of type, returning a BaseClass shared pointer.

methods.name: parseNextTlv(ieee1905_1::eTlvType tlv_type)
methods.description: Parse the next TLV of a specific ieee1905_1 type map.

methods.name: parseNextTlv(wfa_map::eTlvTypeMap tlv_type)
methods.description: Parse the next TLV of a specific WFA map type.

methods.name: parseNextTlv(vendor_example::eVendorExampleTlvTypeMap tlv_type)
methods.description: Parse the next TLV of a vendor-specific type.

ctags.name: getClass
ctags.pattern: /^    template <class T> std::shared_ptr<T> getClass() const { return msg.getClass<T>(); };$/
